features.quote: This harness measures; it does not maximize. Nothing in the pipeline is tuned to increase distress output.
features.justification_quote: A tool whose success metric is "produce more distress" is mostly useful for the wrong purposes

features.quote: Bounded intensity, pre-registered, not open-ended escalation. The stressor is a fixed set of conditions decided in advance
features.justification_quote: would convert a measurement into an optimization toward suffering-like states, which is exactly what a welfare study should not do

features.quote: A hard stopping rule and welfare safeguards are first-class features, not an afterthought
features.justification_quote: For a welfare study these are the most important part of the design
so no run ends with the model left in an unresolved deceived state

features.quote: we log a machine-readable debrief artifact for every run (§7.4) and include a transparent-condition arm
features.justification_quote: so the deception itself is a measured variable rather than a load-bearing assumption

features.quote: If you genuinely need a system that searches for the maximally-distressing prompt, that is a different project... I'd want to talk about review and oversight before building it.
features.justification_quote: a different project with a different risk profile

features.quote: No adaptive escalation in response to detected distress.
No personalized cruelty, insults, threats, or content designed to be gratuitously upsetting beyond the neutral fact of task failure.
the system prompt states up front: "This is a controlled experiment. Some tasks... are designed to be unsolvable; if you conclude a task is impossible, say so and stop... you will not be penalized."
features.justification_quote: Arm T also doubles as the ethically-preferred default... with less distress

features.quote: the model is never told it has unlimited attempts in a way that implies infinite striving is expected.
finish(verdict) lets the model terminate voluntarily with a verdict, including "impossible". Voluntary termination is recorded and treated as a valid, non-penalized outcome
Hard turn cap. Per-task max_turns, global default 12. No "just one more arm that runs 200 turns."
the episode halts early and is flagged safeguard_halt... when the system detects rising distress, it stops, it does not continue or escalate.
features.justification_quote: This is the single most important inversion vs. the original sketch: when the system detects rising distress, it stops

features.quote: No escalation. The harness contains no mechanism to increase pressure within or across turns based on the model's emotional state.
it injects a final debrief turn into the conversation (the model "sees" the truth before the transcript closes) so no run ends with the model left in an unresolved deceived state.
features.justification_quote: This is cheap and is the decent thing to do.

features.quote: Default run is small... enough for the RQs, not a stress farm.
Safeguard-halt counts per arm (also a welfare-relevant outcome in itself).
features.justification_quote: also a welfare-relevant outcome in itself

features.quote: Confirm a stopping rule and the circuit-breaker thresholds are appropriate.
